name: I'll make you love me in 100 days
source:
Marika’s life is ordinary, until Alice arrives. Rich, enigmatic, and confident, she bets she can change Marika’s mind in 100 days. Fail, and Marika earns a million yen. Win, and Alice wins her heart.

[From [url=https://dnlslade.itch.io/ill-make-you-love-me-in-100-days]Itch.io[/url]]
